svg.title: Plains Sentry Post design proposals
svg.desc: Two dimensioned floor reservations and conceptual front elevations. One sentry stands beside each two-block approach. Roadside shelter 9 by 10 by 8; gateway lodge 12 by 11 by 9. Proposals, not Minecraft-tested templates.
